chapter: New Orleans bands: Cheek, Parker, Morgan
title: The Rinky Dinks name
summary: Jones's group was called the Rinky Dinks, a name taken from the funny papers.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: What about, you were telling me about the Rinky Dinks.
What are the Rinky Dinks? That was my group. I had a group by that name and they had some other group downtown too. But I had a group by that name.
What does that mean though, Rinky Dinks?
I don't know, I just pick up that name for publicity. Yeah, I see. That'll be alright. I took that name out of the funny paper, you know. I see.
